sloka: अनेन तपसा त्वाम् हि राज ऋषिर् इति विद्महे ।एवम् उक्त्वा महातेजा जगाम सह दैवतैः ॥१-५७-६॥
transliteration: anena tapasā tvām hi rāja ṛṣir iti vidmahe ।evam uktvā mahātejā jagāma saha daivataiḥ ॥1-57-6॥

translations.english: Having heard the confused words uttered by the sages in a state of anger, the king said again:
